decision_titles: Winter Holiday and New Year Art Exhibition and Market
plain_text:
PAGE 1 
 
SOUTH BURLINGTON  
PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE MEETING 
Tuesday, October 20, 2026 
The South Burlington PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE held a meeting on Tuesday, October 20, 
2026, at 5:30 p.m. at 180 Market Street in Room 301, and by remote participation.  
Members Present: Sebastian Ryder (Chair), Amanda Holland, Sophia Babbitt, Isaac Cates 
(Vice-Chair), Karen Liamos, Thomas Lindley, Penne Tompkins, Bryce Myers, Ilona Blanchard 
(Staff Liaison, non-voting), Tim Barritt (City Council Liaison, non-voting)   
Members Not Present: Mark Behr, Michele Bailey (Vermont Art Council, non-voting) 
 
Also in Attendance: None. 
1. The meeting was convened at 5:30 p.m. by Sebastian. 
a. Ilona reviewed emergency procedures. 
b. Bryce was identified as the minute taker for the meeting. 
 
2. Agenda Review 
a. A request was made to add the reappointment of Maedeh as Gallery Curator for 
the coming year to the agenda under South Burlington Public Art Gallery. The 
addition was approved. 
 
3. Minutes from September 10 and September 15 were reviewed and approved with 
minor corrections. 
a. September 10: Penne noted corrections to the spelling of her name and to the 
date formatting. The Vice-Chair position needs to be updated in the meeting 
templates to reflect Isaac’s role. 
 
4. Opportunity for public comments on items not on the agenda: No members of the 
public were present. 
 
5. Green Community Festival Recap 
a. Members reported a positive experience. Engagement was high and the 
interactive art activity was a success. 
b. Many attendees asked about the committee. The committee suggested creating 
a dedicated sign for future events. 
 
6. City Updates 
a. Downtown Investment Agreement 
i. The City and SB3C are now seeking community signatures on the 
agreement.
Public Art Committee Meeting | Page 2 
ii. The goal is downtown designation (Step 3), which would allow SB3C 
to apply for state funding and tax-free construction materials for 
downtown development projects. 
iii. Staff explained the downtown designation levels (steps) and the 
community support agreement is needed to move from the level 2 
designation to the level 3 designation. 
b. City Council 
i. The Council is seeking community feedback through a survey for FY28 
budget planning. The budget will be presented at the March town 
meeting. 
ii. The Council received a briefing on the Parks and Open Space Master 
Plan from consultant CivicSol. 
iii. The Hubbard Park bike path is complete. Plans to connect it to South 
Village will go through a hearing process. 
iv. Penne noted that the public park and open space advisory group will 
meet in early November to review the latest report and provide input. 
 
7. South Burlington Public Art Gallery 
a. Winter Holiday and New Year Art Exhibition and Market 
i. The committee accepted the proposal, with recommendations to clarify 
the date and correct some editing errors. 
ii. The event will be held on Sunday, December 6, at the Senior Center to 
accommodate more artists. 
iii. There will be an open call for Vermont artists to participate in the 
exhibit, the market, or both. 
b. Gallery Curator 
i. Maedeh was reappointed as the Public Art Gallery Curator for the 
coming year. 
c. Gallery and Library Cross-Promotion 
i. A member noted that the library receives coverage in The Other Paper 
while gallery exhibits do not, and proposed cross-promoting gallery 
openings with the library through community notes or articles to 
increase attendance. 
 
8. Community Events 
a. Join or Die Movie Event 
i. The committee will share a table with other local community groups, 
including the Library Foundation and the Rotary Club of South 
Burlington. 
ii. Sebastian will represent the committee if her work schedule allows and 
will contact Mira about participation. 
iii. The committee will bring copies of the annual report and name tags. 
b. Nonfiction Comics Fest
Public Art Committee Meeting | Page 3 
i. The festival will be held at Fletcher Free Library on Saturday, 
November 14. Isaac will moderate a panel. 
 
9. Public Art and Sculpture 
a. Jambo Sculpture Dedication 
i. Dates considered included October 30 and November 3, 4, and 5. 
ii. The committee will aim for Wednesday, November 4, at 3:00 p.m., with 
Thursday, November 5, as a backup. 
iii. The date needs to be coordinated with the City Council, the donor, and 
the artist. 
b. Infinite Hue Sculpture (JayCee Park) 
i. Penne noted that the sculpture has scratches on the plexiglass surface 
and possible moisture damage. 
ii. Ilona will look at the artists owner’s manual for maintenance to see if 
there are possible remedies and to contact Public Works to handle any 
repairs. 
 
10. Annual Report FY 2026 
a. The annual report was reviewed and approved with minor revisions: 
i. Language about the Parks and Open Space Master Plan will be updated 
to describe advocating for public art in the plan, rather than referring to 
a letter that was not sent. 
ii. Formatting corrections will be made. 
iii. A photo caption will be changed from “missing” to “not shown.” 
 
11. Other Business 
a. Members noted South Burlington’s strong retail market and downtown 
development. Market Street is expected to be fully rented within a year or so. 
b. The meeting was adjourned at 7 p.m. The next meeting will be on Tuesday, 
November 17, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. 
 
 
Respectfully Submitted, 
 
BryceMyers
